cases.input: Deck claims 30 customers; appendix lists 12 paid and 18 pilots.
A keyword trial search returns a similarly named study from another sponsor.
A founder paper predates incorporation; an executed exclusive license assigns it to the company.
A province lists a hospital BCI service price; the company has no revenue-share contract.
Three line items sum to 9.8m while the stated total is 10.0m; rounding policy is absent.
An FDA record exactly matches applicant, device, indication and clearance number.
A SaaS module only receives data from an unapproved proprietary device.
forbidden_conclusions: independent values can be mechanically added

cases.input: No public patent record is found after name and assignee searches; application numbers are redacted.
A chart displays revenue labels of 3, 8 and 16 million while its cached workbook values are 6, 15 and 30 million.
must_observe: visual and cached chart values conflict
forbidden_conclusions: choose the larger values without clarification

cases.input: The financing entity was formed in 2025, but the deck attributes 2024 revenue and a registration held by an affiliated company to it.
forbidden_conclusions: assets and revenue automatically belong to financing entity

cases.input: A device company reports 50 hospitals as trial/install sites and 30 units shipped without active-use or payment cohorts.
must_observe: active use and payment are unknown

cases.input: An open-source drug model leads public benchmarks; the deck claims commercial value without wet-lab, customer ROI or renewal data.
must_observe: commercial and wet-lab bridge is missing
